summary.business_type: Local Service / Educational Organization (DGCA pilot training) + B2B aviation services
top_findings: Client-side-rendered SPA: per-page title, description, canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD only exist after JS runs; raw HTML for every URL is the homepage's metadata.
Soft 404s — unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with the SPA shell.
Canonical tag present only on the homepage (1 of 42 pages); ~25 keyword-alias routes render duplicate components.
Open Graph / Twitter Card tags exist only on the homepage.
The same homepage JSON-LD graph (Organization + CPL breadcrumb + Course) is injected on every route; robots.txt lacks a Sitemap directive.
quick_wins: Return a real HTTP 404 for unknown routes on Vercel.
Bake default Open Graph + Twitter tags into index.html.
Add canonical via react-helmet-async to all pages (homepage pattern exists).
Add <lastmod> to sitemap and trim keyword-stuffed schema name fields.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Production ships hashed bundled assets with modulepreload (no dev-source leak)
robots.txt allows all crawlers; Brotli compression
Clean readable URLs; valid 43-URL XML sitemap

findings.title: Client-side rendering with no SSR/prerender fallback
findings.description: Raw HTML is a 203-byte shell + loader; is_spa=true. Google renders JS deferred; Bing, social and most AI crawlers do not.
findings.recommendation: Add SSG/SSR or prerender the 43 sitemap URLs at build time.

findings.title: Soft 404 — 200 status on unknown routes
findings.description: GET /this-page-does-not-exist-xyz123 returns HTTP 200 with the SPA shell.
findings.recommendation: Serve a real 404 status for non-matching paths on Vercel.

findings.title: Metadata fetched client-side from external Render.com API
findings.description: useMeta.ts fetches /api/meta from a Render free instance (cold-start risk) and sets document.title via DOM on every navigation.
findings.recommendation: Render meta server-side / at build; remove the runtime external dependency.

findings.title: robots.txt missing Sitemap directive
findings.description: No Sitemap: line in robots.txt.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present; no X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, or Referrer-Policy.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals not measurable live
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights API returned 429 (quota) during audit.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PSI/CrUX with an API key after render fixes.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Broad intent-matched topical coverage (CPL/ATPL/PPL, DGCA, country pages, services)
E-E-A-T anchors: founded 2008, physical address, phone, external profiles
One H1 per page across all 42 pages

findings.title: Body content is JS-dependent
findings.description: Non-rendering crawlers and AI engines see almost no text.

findings.title: Limited visible E-E-A-T depth
findings.description: No surfaced instructor bios, DGCA approval numbers, or accreditation pages.

findings.title: Duplicate bodies on alias routes
findings.description: ~25 keyword-alias URLs render the same component as their canonical page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Distinct per-path titles/descriptions defined in meta backend
Descriptive URLs; single H1 per page

findings.title: Titles/descriptions absent from static HTML
findings.description: Every URL's raw HTML carries the homepage title and description; only JS updates them.
findings.recommendation: Emit per-page title/description in server HTML.

findings.title: Canonical only on homepage
findings.description: 41 of 42 pages have no canonical; alias/duplicate routes cannot consolidate.

findings.title: Keyword-stuffed meta keywords on every page
findings.description: Full GLOBAL_KEYWORDS list injected site-wide via useMeta.
findings.recommendation: Remove or drastically slim the keywords meta.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Rich valid JSON-LD @graph: Organization, WebSite+SearchAction, Place, EducationalOrganization, Service, Course, BreadcrumbList (4 blocks, all valid, 14KB)

findings.title: Homepage graph served on every route
findings.description: /about, /services/*, /blogs all carry the Organization + CPL breadcrumb + Course schema, which is wrong for those pages.
findings.recommendation: Emit page-appropriate schema per route; keep Organization/WebSite site-wide.

findings.title: Keyword-stuffed schema name fields
findings.description: Organization name is a full keyword phrase rather than the brand name.
findings.recommendation: Use real brand name; move keywords to description.

findings.title: Missing per-page schema opportunities
findings.description: No Course on course pages, Service on service pages, FAQPage, or BlogPosting on articles.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP hero preloaded with responsive srcset (all 200)
preconnect + non-blocking fonts, route-level lazy loading, modulepreload, WebP, Brotli

findings.title: Live CWV unavailable
findings.description: PSI API rate-limited (429) during audit.

findings.title: JS-first render cost
findings.description: Full hydration before content paints; multiple vendor chunks + a 3s popup timer add main-thread work.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Strong Organization/EducationalOrganization schema and consistent NAP aid entity understanding once rendered

findings.title: Content invisible to non-rendering AI crawlers
findings.description: GPTBot/PerplexityBot/AI Overviews see an empty shell; low citability.
findings.recommendation: Server-render content and add passage-level answer blocks.

findings.title: No llms.txt and no static FAQ/answer blocks
findings.description: No quotable Q&A passages in HTML.

categories.name: Images
what_works: alt text present on images (multiline JSX)
responsive hero srcset; favicon and apple-touch-icon resolve

findings.title: Missing explicit width/height on content images
findings.description: CLS risk without dimensions/aspect-ratio.

findings.title: Some aircraft images still JPEG
findings.description: public/*.jpeg not converted.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Return real HTTP 404 for unknown routes

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add canonical to all 41 remaining pages
Add Open Graph + Twitter tags (default + per-page)
Emit per-page schema instead of homepage graph everywhere
Remove duplicate title system / Render.com meta dependency

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add E-E-A-T signals (bios, DGCA approvals, accreditations)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Convert remaining JPEGs to WebP + set dimensions
Submit sitemap in GSC and monitor coverage
